articles.title: Sonova (SWX:SOON) Stock Could Trade At A Discount After Its 53% Run
articles.summary: Sonova Holding has enjoyed a strong share price run, and the key issue now is whether that climb is supported by the cash the business is expected to generate. With the spotlight on its cash flows, investors are asking if the current market price fairly reflects Sonova's underlying economic engine. articles.title: Barclays upgrades Sonova as Phonak EON drives hearing-aid market share gains
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays has upgraded Sonova to "overweight" from "underweight", identifying the Swiss hearing-aid manufacturer as its preferred investment in the sector as its latest survey of U.S. audiologists points to improving demand for its newest products.

articles.title: Sonova raises FY27 profit outlook after H1 core EBIT beats by 10%
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Swiss hearing-aid maker Sonova (SIX:SOON) raised its full-year sales and profit growth forecasts on Thursday after first-half core operating profit beat analyst expectations by about 10%, although its new outlook implies slower second-half earnings growth than the market had expected.

articles.title: Sonova shares fall 2% as UBS flags stretched valuation despite brighter outlook
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Swiss hearing aid maker Sonova Holding AG (SIX:SOON) were down over 2% after UBS cut its rating to “neutral” from “buy,” saying a 35% rally since July leaves limited room for further gains.

articles.title: UBS sees attractive risk/reward in three European medtech into Q3 results
articles.summary: Investing.com -- UBS said Convatec, Smith & Nephew and Sonova offer the most attractive risk/reward going into third-quarter results, as it expects revenue and earnings growth across European medical technology to accelerate on currency tailwinds.

articles.title: Sonova shares hit 16-month high after Goldman Sachs upgrades stock to buy
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Sonova Holding (LON:0QPY) shares rose to a 16-month high on Thursday after Goldman Sachs upgraded the hearing-aid maker to "buy" from "neutral" and raised its price target to CHF315 from CHF230.
